details:
Hi VRChat Team and Community,

​Trolling and toxic behavior (like mic-spamming, avatar blocking, and harassment) remain a challenge for the community. Relying solely on manual moderation or instant bans doesn't always solve the root problem, as toxic users often just create alt accounts.

​I want to propose a smarter, automated Rehabilitation & Trust Architecture that protects normal players while giving toxic users a hard but fair path to reform.

​1. The "Troll-Only" Shadow Instance (The Prison)

​When a user accumulates too many rapid warmth-blocks or valid reports from different players, the system automatically drops their status to Nuisance.

​The Logic: Instead of locking them out of the game completely, the backend server quietly routes them. When they try to join a public world, the server automatically generates a hidden instance tagged for toxic users only.

​The Psychology: The toxic player thinks they are in a normal public instance. In reality, they are completely isolated from regular users and can only interact with other shadow-banned trolls. They essentially get a taste of their own medicine.

​2. The "Probationer" Trust Level (The Rehabilitation Path)

​If the system detects that the shadow-banned user has stopped their toxic patterns over a specific period, they are allowed back into the real public worlds. However, they don't go back to being a normal "Visitor". Instead, they receive a new, explicit Trust Level: Probationer.

​Visual UI Indicator: To maintain transparency, the Probationer rank will be completely visible above the user's head, just like any other rank. It will feature a distinct shield icon, colored in a faded, neutral gray (similar to the Nuisance color scheme instead of the clean white Visitor text). This immediately alerts the community that this user is under supervision.

​3. Strict Trust Deficit & The "Insta-Kill" Mechanic

​The Probationer rank places the user on a very tight leash, managed by two core system conditions:

​Trust Points Deficit: Upgrading from Probationer to New User will require significantly more effort. It should require 2x or 3x more clean, active, and positive gameplay hours compared to a standard Visitor to successfully remove the probation status.

​The Probation Flag: While in this state, the user is subject to an immediate rollback condition. If a regular user submits a valid report or a Vote Kick against a Probationer, the system skips the usual warning thresholds and multiple-chance accumulation. The probation flag triggers an instant revocation: the user's avatar shatters visually, and the server immediately teleports them back to the hidden troll instances under the Nuisance rank.

​Why this works:

​Psychological Deterrent: Probationers will be extremely careful not to step out of line, knowing that any single player has the absolute power to instantly send them back to the troll prison.

​Community Awareness: Regular players can easily identify reformed users, allowing them to decide whether to give them a chance or monitor their space.

​Automated Moderation: It heavily reduces the load on human moderators by using automated routing and community-driven checks and balances.

​Would love to hear what the community and the devs think about implementing a system like this!
title: Feature Proposal: "The Probationer" Trust Level & Shadow-Banned Instance System for Toxic Users
